gloss: anyway; in any case; at any rate

definitions.gloss: anyway; in any case; at any rate; be that as it may
definitions.explanation: Used to set aside or acknowledge previous points and move on to the main point or conclusion.

examples.japanese: ともあれ、{無事|ぶじ}でよかった。
{理由|りゆう}はともあれ、{結果|けっか}は{良|よ}かった。
examples.english: Whatever the reason, the result was good.

examples.japanese: ともあれ、まず{始|はじ}めてみよう。
examples.english: In any case, let's try starting first.

examples.japanese: {細|こま}かいことはともあれ、{大筋|おおすじ}は{決|き}まった。
examples.english: Setting aside the details, the general outline is decided.

notes:
POSITION:
Typically appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause.

VARIATIONS:
- ともあれ (standard)
- {何|なに}はともあれ: in any case; first of all
- いずれにせよともあれ: regardless; in any event

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ともあれ vs. とにかく vs. いずれにせよ
  - ともあれ: setting aside previous points to make the main point (somewhat formal)
  - とにかく: anyway, at any rate (more emphatic/casual)
  - いずれにせよ: in any case (formal)

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. More commonly used in written language than in casual conversation.

GRAMMAR PATTERN:
～はともあれ: setting aside ~; regardless of ~
- {結果|けっか}はともあれ: regardless of the result
- {過去|かこ}はともあれ: setting aside the past
